evidence.quote: Free Care: The gross (undiscounted) charge amount for eligible services will be waived for applicants whose total Income is at or below 200% of the current federal poverty level, shown on Appendix A.

tiers.description: 75% discount for income 201%-300% FPL per Appendix A table
65% discount for income 301%-400% FPL per Appendix A table

residency.area: MCHS service area (State of Wisconsin and the Upper Peninsula of Michigan) for non-emergent medically necessary services; not required for emergency services

evidence.quote: Financial assistance is available for services required for an Emergency Medical Condition regardless of whether a patient resides within Marshfield Clinic Health System’s service area.
MCHS will accept a financial assistance application for at least 240 days following the patient/guarantor’s first billing statement or as deemed reasonable.

presumptive_eligibility: Presumptive eligibility grants 100% free care based on socio-economic factors such as means-tested program eligibility, homelessness, or low-income housing residency.
how_to_apply: Mail or hand-deliver to Marshfield Clinic Health System Patient Financial Assistance Center, 3Q4 1000 North Oak Avenue, Marshfield, WI 54449; phone 1-800-782-8581, ext. 94475; application at https://marshfieldclinic.org/patient-resources/billing/financial-assistance
warnings: Policy does not explicitly mention an asset test; only qualified health accounts (HSA/FSA) are expected to be used, and account statements may be requested as income documentation.
Counted from first billing statement (not specifically post-discharge); window is 'at least' 240 days.
Catastrophic cap: 100% discount on guarantor balances exceeding 10% of income when at or below 600% FPL.
Appendix A table header reads 'Less than or equal to 100-200%'; free care at or below 200% FPL taken from section 3.5.
Many outside provider groups are not covered by this policy (Appendix C).
Non-emergency residency rule depends on primary residence relative to service area and nature of care; not a flat requirement.
